name: booking-retry-agent
description: Outbound booking agent for the booking_retry cookbook recipe.
firstMessage: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling from the clinic about the appointment you asked for. Is now a good time for one minute?

voiceMailDetectionConfig.endText: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling from the clinic about your appointment request. I am sorry I missed you. I will try you again later, or you can call the clinic back anytime. Goodbye.

postCallAnalytics.summaryPrompt: Summarize the call in two sentences: who answered, and whether a day and time was agreed. Do not include health details.

dispositionMetrics.dispositionMetricPrompt: What was the result of this call? Use no_conversation if nobody spoke to the agent.
If an appointment was booked, the agreed day and time in plain words. Otherwise leave empty.
